title: Dossier (admission gate record)
description: Scored dossier that moves a mechanism through lifecycle gates (SPEC.md §3.3). The prose is part of the scientific record, not decoration (Option A): each axis carries a markdown rationale, and the dossier carries a markdown dissent statement and a core_condition — JSON is the single source of truth, /dossiers renders it. Thresholds enforced by the validator and the owner: to enter INCUBATING — total >= 11 AND scores.evidence.score >= 2 AND scores.safety.score >= 2; to enter CORE — additionally at least one measured effect (from our loop or public corpora), stated in core_condition.

scores.description: Five scoring axes, each an integer 0–3 with its markdown rationale

total.description: Sum of the five axis scores. Gate: incubating requires total >= 11 (with evidence >= 2 and safety >= 2). The validator checks total equals the sum of scores[*].score.

core_condition.description: The explicit condition under which this mechanism may be promoted to CORE — measured, not assumed.

dissent.description: Documented counter-evidence (markdown). Every dossier must address dissent — a record that can only confirm is broken (D-019).

verdict.description: Lifecycle decision this dossier supports. 'core' additionally requires at least one measured effect.

rationale.description: Markdown justification for the score — the scientific reasoning, entered by the owner.
